# Is CDL school worth it? What it costs to get in, and how many months of driving pay it back

> Free CDL school payback calculator: tuition, fees, weeks out of work, weekly miles and pay per mile become the cost to get in, the monthly gain over your current job, months to pay it back and company-paid training versus paying yourself. Private, runs in your browser.

Free and open source (MIT). Results are estimates from the numbers typed in, not legal, tax, financial or professional advice.

- [The tool](https://duncan-haywood.github.io/oss-monorepo/cdl-school-payback-calculator/)
